title: Lottie
summary: Vector accents in the theme style, generated from code in lottie/generate.mjs: brushed marks that draw on, soft reactions, small nature motifs and looping backgrounds on mint-cream paper.

items.name: Scribble loops
items.description: The theme’s brush mark: three loose green loops drawn in one stroke, finished with a dot.

items.name: Underline squiggle
items.description: A wavy green underline draws on, with a thinner ink line beneath: emphasis under a word.

items.name: Circle highlight
items.description: A hand-drawn clay ring loops around a word, with three little emphasis ticks.

items.name: Arrow draw
items.description: A hand-drawn arrow that starts at a dot, loops once and points right: “look here”, “next”.

items.name: Heart pop
items.description: A clay heart swells up softly on a blush disc while small rays draw out: love it, saved, favourite.

items.name: Star rating
items.description: Five stars fill one after another (the last one half strength): reviews and ratings.

items.name: Check tick
items.description: A leaf-green disc grows inside a drawn ring and the tick writes itself: done, yes, packed.

items.name: Pin drop
items.description: A map pin glides down onto its shadow and a ring spreads out: location, “we are here”.

items.name: Sprig grow
items.description: A stem draws upward and six leaves unfold in turn: growth, habits, a fresh start.

items.name: Sun turn
items.description: A warm sun with slowly turning rays and a breathing glow (loop): morning, good weather, energy.

items.name: Coffee steam
items.description: A clay cup on a saucer with wisps of steam rising (loop): mornings, breaks, routines.

items.name: Sparkles
items.description: Four-point sparkles twinkling in the theme colours (loop): new, clean, a little magic.

items.name: Blob breathe
items.description: Three soft nested blobs slowly turning and changing shape (loop): calm ambient backdrop.

items.name: Petal drift
items.description: Petals and leaves drifting down and swaying (loop): gentle ambient motion.
